description: Snowflake multi-table INSERT: unconditional INSERT ALL fans every source row into every target, INSERT FIRST routes each row to its first matching WHEN (ELSE catches the rest), INSERT ALL applies every matching WHEN, the per-target VALUES clause evaluates expressions against the source row, and INSERT OVERWRITE truncates the target first. Converted 1:1 from dml/MultiTableInsertTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE src (id INTEGER, v INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE a (id INTEGER, v INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE b (id INTEGER, v INTEGER)
INSERT ALL INTO a INTO b SELECT id, v FROM src
INSERT FIRST WHEN x > 100 THEN INTO big WHEN x > 10 THEN INTO mid ELSE INTO small SELECT x FROM n
INSERT ALL WHEN x > 100 THEN INTO big WHEN x > 10 THEN INTO mid SELECT x FROM n
CREATE TABLE s2 (a INTEGER, b INTEGER)
INSERT ALL INTO t3 (total) VALUES (a + b) SELECT a, b FROM s2
INSERT OVERWRITE ALL INTO ov SELECT x FROM src2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ov WHERE x = 99
